acceptance_oracle: When an already-supported employer-feed import adds jobs for a current profile and a job application URL points to a different website than the enrolled feed origin, the same import transaction records one profile-owned source-candidate observation linked to that job. Reimport is idempotent; rollback leaves no candidate; unknown attribution/hops remain explicit; candidate URLs are sanitized; collection remains disabled; already-enrolled same-origin jobs do not create redundant candidates. The connected Sources UI reads the feed-created record after reload and profile boundaries remain isolated.

red_observation.result: Before implementation, the positive integration oracle failed because the supported feed import produced zero source candidates; the same-origin negative control passed.

implementation: Company-feed imports now record a candidate only for profiles whose profile version is still current and only when the supplied application host differs from the enrolled feed host.

Each observation links the canonical job, records the sanitized feed endpoint and application URL, labels capture_method SUPPORTED_COLLECTION, sets origin attribution UNKNOWN and evidence status PARTIAL, and leaves redirect hops explicitly UNKNOWN.
The deterministic observation request identity makes feed replays idempotent; candidate writes share the feed job transaction so a failed import rolls them back.
Candidate capture/review does not fetch URLs, enroll sources, enable collection, or submit applications.
An additive Alembic revision admits SUPPORTED_COLLECTION observations; downgrade refuses to discard any such evidence.
